verification.note: Editorial introduction printed pp. 133–134 and selected contextual pp. 135–136 read; primary answers pp. 136–140 read, plus fragments of 141–142 on Elias incidentally seen. Later interview/body and complete monographs unread; no complete interview or audio check. Conversation 7 November 1987, manuscript completed 1991, first published 2022 after Douglas’s death. Interviewer/reader claims are distinguished from Douglas’s answers. Introduction has problematic posthumous interview dates and World of Goods 1978 citation; those are not adopted. Text transcriptions may contain errors, including personal names in recollections.
